title: Synthesis, antimicrobial properties and in silico evaluation of coumarin derivatives mediated by 1,4-dibromobutane.
authors: Tiakouang, Eunice N; Ewonkem, Monique B; Moto, Jean O; Adjieufack, Abel I; Deussom, Pascaline M; Mbock, Michel A; Ngeufa, Emmanuel H; Toze, Alfred F A; Wansi, Duplex J
one_liner_zh: 该文合成香豆素衍生物并评估其抗菌活性，通过分子对接和MD模拟研究其与DNA的结合稳定性，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（DNA小分子结合）且方法可迁移，但非TF-DNA体系且互作机制深度有限。
abstract: In this study, monobrominated coumarins (5-6) and bis-coumarins (7-9) were synthesized from 3-carboxylic coumarin and 7-hydroxy-4-methyl coumarin using 1,4-dibromobutane as a binding agent, according to the synthesis procedures described in the literature. Amongst these coumarins, three are new compounds: monobrominated coumarin 5 and bis-coumarins 7 and 9. The structures of the synthesized coumarins were confirmed by FTIR, NMR and HRMS-ESI. In vitro antimicrobial evaluation of these coumarins against strains of twelve bacteria and four fungi revealed their bactericidal and fungicidal properties, with increased antibacterial activity for monocoumarins and improved antifungal activity for bis-coumarins. It was also found that the antibacterial activity was enhanced by the etheric bond, Br atom and alkyl chain and reduced by the ester bonds at position 3 of the pyrone ring or an additional coumarin unit, while the antifungal activity was reinforced by ester bonds and deactivated by the Br atom. For the first time, the in silico investigations of such coumarins were carried out and it was observed that they are less toxic, suitable for oral administration with good permeability through cell membrane, are able to circulate freely in the bloodstream and cross Blood-Brain-Barriers. Moreover, their molecular docking in DNA indicated stable coumarin-DNA complexes with good scores. The results of molecular dynamics simulations performed for 200 ns revealed the rigidity and stability of bis-coumarins (7-9) in the DNA binding pocket and predict that they are potent binders.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，根据文献所述的合成步骤，以1,4-二溴丁烷为连接剂，从3-羧基香豆素和7-羟基-4-甲基香豆素合成了单溴代香豆素（5-6）和双香豆素（7-9）。在这些香豆素中，有三种是新化合物：单溴代香豆素5和双香豆素7和9。合成香豆素的结构通过FTIR、NMR和HRMS-ESI确认。对这些香豆素针对十二种细菌和四种真菌菌株的体外抗菌评估揭示了其杀菌和杀真菌特性，其中单香豆素的抗菌活性增强，双香豆素的抗真菌活性提高。还发现，抗菌活性通过醚键、Br原子和烷基链增强，而通过吡喃环3位酯键或额外香豆素单元减弱；抗真菌活性则通过酯键增强，并被Br原子失活。首次对此类香豆素进行了计算机模拟研究，观察到它们毒性较低，适合口服给药，具有良好的细胞膜通透性，能够在血液中自由循环并穿越血脑屏障。此外，它们在DNA中的分子对接表明形成了稳定的香豆素-DNA复合物，得分良好。对200 ns的分子动力学模拟结果显示，双香豆素（7-9）在DNA结合口袋中具有刚性和稳定性，预测它们是强效结合剂。
